home_scanning.intro_description: Scan four rooms of your home to find hazards before you exercise. It takes about 15 minutes.
home_scanning.save_failed: The image could not be saved.
hs.tagline: Find hazards. Fix them. Unlock your exercise.
hs.exercise_zone_default: The Living Room is your default Exercise Zone.
hs.exercise_locked: Locked. Scan all four rooms to unlock.
hs.exercise_open: Unlocked. You are cleared to exercise.
hs.rule.lights: Turn on all main lights and open the curtains. Do not point the camera at a bright window.
hs.rule.people: Clear people and pets out of the picture.
hs.rule.dont_tidy: Do not tidy first. Photograph the room as it normally is.
hs.rule.height: Hold the device at chest height, tilted slightly down, so the floor fills at least one third of the picture.
hs.rule.landscape: Turn the device sideways (landscape) for room photos.
hs.rule.hold_still: Hold still for 2 seconds until all READY lights are green.
hs.rule.all_shots: Take all required photos. Bonus photos earn extra XP.
hs.shot.bedroom_bedside: From beside the bed, looking back to the door
hs.shot.kitchen_stove: Facing the stove and cooking area
hs.shot.kitchen_sink: Facing the sink and wet area
hs.shot.dining_far: From the far side of the table
hs.shot.living_exercise: Exercise Zone: stand back to show a clear floor of 2 m x 2 m
hs.clearance.title: Exercise clearance
hs.disclaimer: This is a screening aid. It is not a substitute for an occupational therapist's home assessment.
hs.cam.rotate: Tip: turn the device sideways for room photos.
hs.cam.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow the camera in your browser settings and tap Retry, or upload a photo from your gallery.
hs.cam.none: No camera was found. You can upload a photo from your gallery instead.
hs.q.too_dark: Too dark. Turn on the lights or open the curtains.
hs.q.too_bright: Too bright. Do not point at a window.
hs.q.blurry: The picture is blurry. Hold still.
hs.q.tilt_roll: Level the device. Do not tilt it sideways.
hs.q.tilt_down: Tilt the device down a little to show the floor.
hs.q.tilt_up: Tilt the device up a little.
hs.q.people: Please clear people out of the room.
